clips.title: The story
paras: Along the road from Durotar to the Crossroads, Grol'dom Farm raises swine in the northern Barrens. Kranal Fiss and his family work the homestead, despite constant harassment from aggressive local quilboars.

Established after Durotar was settled, Grol'dom Farm is an early Horde effort to farm the dry Barrens. Kranal Fiss and his children tend the homestead and raise pigs, while Razormane quilboar raiders prowl the nearby ridges. The farm supplies sustenance to the emerging orcish nation, though life here remains lonely and rugged.

Grol'dom Farm is a pig farm, but its purpose reaches beyond that daily work. Kranal Fiss knows the elemental rites and plays a key part in guiding young shaman through their trials. Horde initiates on the spiritual path hold the farm in quiet regard, and seekers traveling west from Orgrimmar are regularly directed here to learn how to commune with the primal spirits of fire.
